## PEAK MEMORY (local GPU)

- **Setup:** local, bfloat16, autocast, swept=prompt_length, repeat=3
- **Cells:** largest `prompt_length` whose peak stays within N% of the model footprint (`>=` hit the length cap, `<` already over at the smallest length)

### activation_patching

![activation_patching — peak memory](data:image/png;base64,)

| Model | Params | Footprint | 10% | 25% | 50% |
|-------|--------|----------:|----:|----:|----:|
| google/gemma-3-1b-pt | (default) | 1.86GiB | <2 | 11 | 47 |
| meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B | (default) | 14.96GiB | 119 | 298 | 596 |
| openai-community/gpt2 | (default) | 237.4MiB | <2 | 25 | 70 |

### j_lens

![j_lens — peak memory](data:image/png;base64,)

| Model | Params | Footprint | 10% | 25% | 50% |
|-------|--------|----------:|----:|----:|----:|
| google/gemma-3-1b-pt | top_k=5, include_entropy=True | 1.86GiB | 13 | 34 | 70 |
| meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B | top_k=5, include_entropy=True | 14.96GiB | 182 | 461 | 925 |
| openai-community/gpt2 | top_k=5, include_entropy=True | 237.4MiB | 17 | 44 | 90 |
